{{Dialogue|Saman|Only other way into the Pangarees is up the Rimma all the way to Corlaasi, then along the Dravin Cut to the Chundu Shunt &mdash;|Fanaso|That's a hike.|Kiardi|Sure is.|attr=[[Saman]], [[Shandy Fanaso]] and [[Kiardi]]|src=<ref name="DTM">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/triton20080820.html|text="Deader than a Triton Moon"|int=Deader than a Triton Moon|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>}}
The '''Dravin Cut''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] accessible via [[Corlaasi]] on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. It was a gateway to the [[Chundu Shunt]].<ref name="DTM" /> The Dravin Cut shared its name with the [[Dravin system/Legends|Dravin system]],<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=|other=the Dravin Cut|system=[[Dravin system/Legends|Dravin system]]|homeworld=|canon=|legends=1}}</ref> a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
